definition: The document a person keeps that teaches a machine who they are — voice, history, preferences, standards; the self, made portable and legible.
in_use: New model, same me. I hand over the soulfile and we’re working in minutes.
the_case: The object already exists in every serious practitioner’s workflow and has no name; and file’s own etymology — a thread — quietly stitches it to threadfray at the loom.
seo_title: soulfile: the document that teaches a machine who you are
